title: When I was little
goal: Talk about childhood and the old days: where you lived, what you did, what Ba used to say.
tip: For what used to happen, use the -તો form on its own. It agrees like an adjective: હું રમતો (a boy), હું રમતી (a girl), અમે રમતા. Add હતો, હતી or હતા for "was doing": હું વાંચતો હતો. જ્યારે … ત્યારે joins "when … then".

items.notes: રહેવું → રહે + તા. A man alone says રહેતો, a woman રહેતી.

items.english: We used to live in the village.
alts: We lived in the village
We used to live in a village

items.english: I used to play cricket every day (a boy speaking).
alts: I used to play cricket every day
I played cricket every day
She used to play garba
She danced garba
items.notes: Garba is "played" in Gujarati: ગરબા રમવા.

items.english: Ba used to tell us stories.
alts: Grandma used to tell us stories
Ba told us stories
items.notes: કહેતાં with the ાં ending, out of respect for Ba.

items.english: Grandpa used to go to the temple every morning.
alts: Grandpa went to the temple every morning
Grandfather used to go to the temple every morning

items.notes: ક્યારે? asks when. જ્યારે … ત્યારે says when something happened.
The past of નથી, and it agrees: નહોતો, નહોતી, નહોતું, નહોતા.

items.gujarati: જ્યારે હું નાનો હતો, ત્યારે અમે ગામમાં રહેતા.
items.translit: jyaare hun naano hato, tyaare ame gaammaan rahetaa.
items.english: When I was little, we lived in the village (a man speaking).
alts: When I was little, we lived in the village
When I was small, we used to live in the village
When I was little we used to live in the village

items.gujarati: હું નાની હતી ત્યારે બહુ રમતી.
items.translit: hun naanee hatee tyaare bahu ramtee.
items.english: When I was little I played a lot (a woman speaking).
alts: When I was little I used to play a lot
When I was small I played a lot
items.notes: જ્યારે is often left out: the ત્યારે is enough.

items.english: Back then there were no phones.
alts: There were no phones then
At that time there were no phones
I was reading
Mom was asleep
Mum was sleeping

items.gujarati: તમારો ફોન આવ્યો ત્યારે હું જમતો હતો.
items.translit: tamaaro phon aavyo tyaare hun jamto hato.
items.english: When you called, I was eating (a man speaking).
alts: When you called, I was eating
I was eating when you called

items.english: People used to walk to school before.
alts: In the old days people walked to school
Before, people used to walk to school

items.gujarati: દિવાળીમાં અમે આખી રાત ફટાકડા ફોડતા.
items.translit: divaaLeemaan ame aakhee raat phaTaakDaa phoDtaa.
items.english: At Diwali we used to set off firecrackers all night.
alts: At Diwali we set off firecrackers all night
We used to set off firecrackers all night at Diwali

items.english: As a child I didn't like milk.
alts: When I was a child I did not like milk
As a child I did not like milk
items.notes: ભાવવું is "to like" for food: મને દૂધ ભાવે છે, I like milk.

items.english: Grandpa used to work in the fields.
alts: Grandpa worked in the fields
Grandfather used to work in the fields
